text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You look wonderful today as well, 
Goddesses—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, they seem to carry a different 
presence than usual...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: May I take a closer look? Excuse me, then!
